svg.title: GEO-08 weak derivative, FEM residual, and solution-operator audit
svg.desc: Four panels show delta concentration, finite-element convergence, the separation of strong and Galerkin residuals, and failure of a low-mode truncated Poisson solution operator on high frequencies.
svg.text: GEO-08 reproducibility audit · weak objects, variational balance, and operator spectra
Deterministic · NumPy only · continuum identities, discretization errors, and OOD claims are reported separately.
u_eps = sqrt(x^2+eps^2): u_eps'' concentrates while its mass approaches 2 delta_0
−u″=π²sin(πx), u=0 · exact load quadrature · uniform meshes
piecewise-linear u_h has u_h''=0 inside elements but exact discrete weak balance
Dirichlet Poisson gain sigma_k=(pi k)^-2 · learned truncation keeps k≤8
Reading rule: panel A concerns distributions, B approximation error, C residual topology, D operator-distribution shift. No panel substitutes for the others.
